  const now = new Date();

    case "FNB":
      return [
        {
          id: `prod-fnb-1-${Date.now()}`,
          organizationId,

          costPrice: "8000",

          minWholesaleQty: 10,
          stock: 60,
          unit: "cup",
          minStockAlert: 10,
          imageUrl: "",

          updatedAt: now,

        {
          id: `prod-fnb-2-${Date.now()}`,
          organizationId,
          outletId: "outlet-1",
          name: "Espresso Single Shot",
          sku: "FNB-002",
          barcode: "8990001002",
          category: "Minuman",
          costPrice: "4000",
          sellingPrice: "12000",
